The quotation is about school governance reform — specifically, moving all schools into "strong school trusts" and removing barriers for local authorities to set up such trusts. The core mechanism is an organizational/governance restructuring of educational institutions.

Primary: **I** (Health, Education, and Welfare) — this is directly about education policy, specifically the governance structure of schools.

Secondary: **L** (Industrial Organization) — the formation of school trusts and the structure of how schools organize into multi-academy trust-like entities has an industrial organization dimension (market structure, organizational form of providers).
